name: Circle of Earth (Druid Circle)
body:
You have mastery over earth, metal, and stone, can fire darts of acid, and command earth creatures.

Bonus Spells: magic stone (1st), soften earth and stone (2nd). stone shape (3rd), spike stones (4th), wall of stone (5th), stoneskin 99 (6th), tectonic communion (7th), earthquake (8th), clashing rocks (9th).

Manifestation: You always smell faintly of freshly tilled earth, dust seems to follow where you walk, and your footprints are slightly heavier than normal.

Granted Powers: You gain the following abilities as part of this circle.

Slate Mail (Su)

At 1st level a legendary druid of this circle may form a set of armor from natural earth and stone. By spending 1 minute manipulating natural energies you form a suit of armor onto your body. At 1st level this has the same statistics as a suit of Breastplate. At 4th level, it gains a +1 enhancement bonus, and gains an additional +1 bonus per three levels beyond 5th to a maximum of +5 at 16th level.

As a free action, you may cause your armor to fall off and become normal earth again.

Stubborn as the Bedrock (Su)

You have bonded with energies deep beneath the earth and you’ve learned to mimic the stability of the strongest bedrock. At 8th level a member of the Circle of Earth can enter an unyielding stance as a move action. So long as the legendary druid does not move they cannot be moved from their square (in the same way a tree or castle wall cannot be moved) for a number of rounds equal to their Legendary druid level. They gain DR/Adamantine equal to half their legendary druid level. If the square occupied by the legendary druid is made unable to support their weight, destroyed or moved by other means (such as move earth) or if the legendary druid is knocked unconscious or paralyzed this effect ends and the legendary druid may be moved as normal.

Warp Earth (Sp)

The legendary druid has supreme control over the earth itself in a way usually limited to less material planes of existence. Once per day, you may use the planeswarp ability of the quintessence mastery spell on your home plane of existence. You do not require the usual focus, and the duration lasts until you use this ability again.

Druidic talents

The following talents are available to legendary druids with this circle:

Basic Resistance (Ex)

(Major Talent)

You gain acid resistance equal to twice your class level. At 16th level, this becomes acid immunity.

Heart of Stone (Ex)

(Minor Talent)

You understand the basic essence of earth-based creatures.

You gain the spells charm animal and dominate animal as spells known, but instead of affecting animals, you affect earth elementals and other creatures of the earth subtype.

Improved Slate Mail (Su)

(Minor Talent)

You may choose to form your Slate Mail as a set of Full Plate or Breast Plate and you are proficient in the Slate Mail in either form. Your Slate Mail now also has a focus crystal that can be enchanted as magical armor using the rules for Craft Magical Arms and Armor but only special abilities may be added to the Slate Mail in this way. The crystal has hardness 10 and 30 hit points, plus an additional hit point per legendary druid level you possess. It is small enough to be worked into a necklace or bracelet, but need only be carried on your person to add its special abilities to a set of Slate Mail that you form.

Vitriolic Shards (Su)

(Minor Talent)

When in an area of earth or stone the legendary druid may fire a shard of acid drenched stone, as a standard action, at a target within 30 ft as a ranged touch attack. This attack deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage for every 2 class levels + an amount of acid damage equal to your legendary druid level. When using this ability the legendary druid may expend a spell slot of 1st level or higher to increase the acid damage by 2d6 per level of the expended spell slot.
